decisions_required: Confirm an accessible DOE/ORNL producer source, source owner, release date, and lineage to this exact inventory entry; or explicitly record no maintained feed after the publisher's review.

Provide authoritative geospatial locations for the LNG and LPG/propane facility population in scope. PHMSA bulk annual records identify LNG facilities and types but omit coordinates; PHMSA says coordinates are only proposed in future forms, while public NPMS access is restricted. FERC lists a jurisdictional subset with city/state text only.

Confirm whether the target is intended to include PHMSA-classified Peak Shaving only, Satellite LNG facilities, propane-air plants, or other facilities, and provide the accepted 2022 baseline/crosswalk mapping.
If a third-party candidate is proposed, provide explicit delegation or upstream source evidence and approve its relationship to the historical HIFLD item.
Approve the source and published ID, schema, geometry, rights, refresh, and compatibility contract before implementation or promotion.
